title: mathAgents G-FID fidelity record
description: reports/dossiers/<slug>/fidelity.json. Human statement-fidelity decisions (G-FID), keyed to each declaration's statement_fingerprint from reports/kernel/latest.json. Approvals are human decisions: no agent writes an approval (spec DD-29). A waiver records an operator kernel-as-judge override for one conversation (D5, D26) and yields the label 'proved, fidelity-waived', never plain 'proved' (DD-35).

approver.description: Human approver (required when status is approved).

reading.description: Selected reading id from the Interpretation Brief, if any (e.g. R2).

back_translation.description: Path to, or text of, the independent back-translation reviewed.

toolchain_pin.description: The instance's lean/lean-toolchain when this was recorded (docs/lean-version-governance.md R6). Optional; the dossier validator warns when it differs from the current pin: the approval predates a bump and needs re-approval.

mathlib_rev.description: The Mathlib commit (lake-manifest.json rev) when this was recorded (R6). Optional; checked like toolchain_pin.

conversation.description: Identifier of the conversation in which the operator directed the override.

plan.description: Session plan file recording the override.

lean_namespace.description: Lean namespace holding this dossier's declarations; every kernel-report declaration under it must have an entry (no partial coverage).

intake_sha256.description: SHA-256 over the dossier's problem-card.md and preferences.toml at approval (scripts/preferences.py digest <slug>). Required by the dossier validator when the dossier has a preferences.toml (D32): changing either lapses the approval.
